summary: Built F1 to F4b of the design (the sub-steps are in section 10 and the pages in 4.9; the task text names them 12 and 5): the four shared pure modules (stages.js with the 11 stages and the 20 allowed moves, quick-facts.js, kz.js with the own civil arithmetic at UTC+5, consent.js), the 118 new text keys (ru, kk, en: the footer, the five consent sentences, the page families inv_, acc_, prj_, adm_, qf_ 3 labels and 12 options, stage_ 11, board_new, and the eight auth_err_ texts), api.js (the eight codes, reauthToken, sessionChanges), the rules appended to site.css, the ten pages with their ten scripts, and the footer m2_footer on the four account pages plus the links of the signed-in view of login.html (projects, account, admin for the platform admin).

Every page follows the frame of login.html (PP-2 head, #test-mode, #ai-disclosure, one sai:kk region around the kk button, no order region), the footer #m2-footer, texts by data-t and textContent, no inline style, no innerHTML, no .style, no external address. The invitation page keeps #consent unticked with no checked attribute and #consent-1 to #consent-5 empty in the HTML; the script fills them from consentText and sends the sha256 (Web Crypto) of the exact text shown, with consent_lang; when the server's consent_langs lacks the page language (kk on production) it shows and sends the ru text. Long keys, addresses, titles and notes wrap (overflow-wrap anywhere, pre-wrap texts): no horizontal overflow at 320, 390 and 1470.

issues.text: No divergence from the API table of 4.3 was found; N1 (org.name, org.new, role, consent_langs), N2 (the six body keys), N3 (requested_at), N4 (link), N5 (requests[].user_id, name, email, requested_at), N7 to N14 shapes are read as the table gives them, and /api/auth/me is read for name, platform_admin, memberships[0].{name, role} and deletion_requested_at. The pages were proven against a stub written from the table; the real server of BACKEND-DEV was not started (its routes were still landing), so the link 'server answered -> page showed it' for the new routes is proved by the stub and by the e2e test ACC-1 later.

Element contract: #edit on admin-request.html is the button 'Изменить заявку' that opens #edit-form (the design lists #edit and #edit-form separately); #role on invite.html and account.html is a text value (the role name from the key inv_role_<role>), not a select. ACC-1 should click #edit before filling #edit-text.

Trap for TEST-DESIGNER (M2P-5): the key scan reads every string literal of a page script that matches ^(m2|consent|inv|acc|prj|adm|qf|stage|board)_[a-z0-9_]+$ and demands a texts key. An error code literal such as 'consent_required' matches it; the scripts therefore name that text as auth_err_consent_required. The keys of the template families (stage_<id>, qf_<key>_<id>, inv_role_<role>) are built in the scripts and are all in the module (the static probe checks them).

Choices where the design is silent: a client sees the stage draft as 'Черновик' (stage_draft) and the owner's board as 'Новые' (board_new); the audit page shows the action, actor kind and target as the raw codes of the log (no text key, no translation); the invitation form starts in the 'new organisation' mode with the role fixed to org_owner; admin pages show the not_found text (and the login link) also to an anonymous caller, client pages the auth_required text; the kk values of all new keys except the consent sentences are my drafts (FOR_NATIVE_SPEAKER, not served on production until G9).

site.css: besides the named rules (stage strip, board, rows, version list) the block holds the form-control rules (.fld, .opts/.opt, .check) because the existing sheet styles no input (login.html, setup.html and the other account pages keep the browser look); the new pages look therefore a little different from those four forms. Question О9 stands: the look of the client pages is a functional form on the existing styles; the owner's G21 'похоже' is asked on the UAT screens.
